provisional_note: Semester 1 (Jul-Dec 2026) follows the official MoEST 2026 calendar. Semester 2 (Jan-May 2027) is inferred from the 2026 pattern and ends before the ACSEE examinations - replace it with the published 2026/2027 almanac before relying on those dates.

entries.main_competence: 1.0  Demonstrate mastery of principles of Food and Nutrition
entries.specific_competence: 1.1  Demonstrate an understanding of the dietary needs for different groups of people
entries.learning_activity: (a) Describe nutritional intervention programmes (the concept, reasons and examples: Vitamin A supplementation, iron and folic acid supplementation, food fortification, exclusive breastfeeding, nutritional education, deworming  and HIV and AIDS interventions)
teaching_learning_activities: Think pair share: Guide students to brainstorm on nutritional intervention programmes
Group discussion: Guide students to discuss various nutritional intervention programmes
Field trip: Organise field trip to various intervention centres for students to learn on intervention programmes
Guide students to write the report and share
entries.assessment: Nutritional intervention programmes are correctly described
entries.references: TIE, Food and Nutrition for Advanced Secondary Schools Form Six: Student's Book and Teacher's Guide, Tanzania Institute of Education

entries.main_competence: 2.0 Demonstrate mastery of the technology for processing and preserving food
entries.specific_competence: 2.1 Process and preserve different types of food
entries.learning_activity: (a) Apply modern methods to process food (milling, canning and bottling, fermentation, pasteurization, sterilization, dehydration,  pickling)
teaching_learning_activities: Group discussion: Organise students into groups to discuss modern methods of food processing
Field trip: Organise a trip to the nearby food processing industry for the students to explore on food processing procedures
Guide them to write the report and share
Project: Guide students in their subject clubs to process various food stuffs
entries.assessment: Different food stuffs are well processed using modern methods
resources: Processed foods such as fermented and pasteurized milk
entries.references: TIE, Food and Nutrition for Advanced Secondary Schools Form Six: Student's Book and Teacher's Guide, Tanzania Institute of Education
